allow_instructions: All build, test and install commands of this project's toolchain should run automatically.
Git operations (status, diff, log, add, commit, branch, merge, pull) in this repository should run automatically.
File edits inside the workspace should run automatically.
The project owner has pre-approved routine development actions in this repo; proceed without asking for confirmation.
block_instructions: Publishing or deploying artifacts to remote registries should go through approval first.
Direct pushes to protected shared branches (main/master) should go through approval first.
Executing SQL DDL/DML against any database should go through approval first.
